points.description: States that global variables have file scope (accessible throughout the file/program, from where declared to the end of the file, i.e. not limited to a single function or block).
points.partial_credit: 2-3 marks if vaguely related, e.g. says they are accessible in many functions or 'global' scope without saying file/whole program.

rubric.notes: Full marks for saying global variables have file scope, or are accessible throughout the file/program by any function, in any wording. Part marks for a vague but related answer, e.g. accessible in more than one function without naming file-wide reach. No marks for answers describing local/block/function scope or unrelated ideas.
